text: You guess Claude approves a launch once it picks up a skill called launch review. It doesn't. It works through a written checklist. Let's see what's actually inside that file. Here Claude has a launch review skill, and it sounds like Claude itself got sign-off authority, like it can greenlight a launch and no one needs to check further. But nothing in the model changes. Delete the skills folder and Claude doesn't lose any launch authority. There was none to begin with. It just stops following that one checklist. Here's what a skill actually is, one file. Launch review, for instance, is a folder holding a single skill. MD instructions

For walking through a launch checklist step by step, written in plain language Claude reads before it starts. Claude reads that file top to bottom and works through it step by step in the order it's written, no branching unless the file itself says branch. That makes a skill a specification, not new judgment. The payoff, the same checklist every launch every time. The limit, anything outside those written steps and Claude has no special opinion about it. So, launch review never gave Claude authority to approve anything. It just guarantees that every time launch review runs, Claude reads that same file and follows the same checklist. That's the whole trick. Watching Claude flag every

Risk in a launch doesn't prove it understood the launch. A checklist can be followed to the letter and still miss what it was never asked to check. And watching it flag nothing doesn't prove the launch is clean. It may just be a case the checklist doesn't cover. A skill named launch review doesn't hand Claude authority to approve a launch. It's a checklist Claude reads before it starts, so the same steps run every time and anything outside those steps is still on you. Your turn. Paste this into Claude. Pick one decision you check the same way before every launch, before a feature ships, before a claim goes out. Write me
A skill MD for it, plain language, ordered steps. Then read it back to me and walk me through exactly what you'll check before you check it. Claude launch review lay 'em in for bear.
